brief:
Middle East Eye spoke with Antony Loewenstein, an independent journalist and author of *The Palestine Laboratory*, following recent Israeli election results. Loewenstein characterized the outcome as reflecting a political environment in which, he stated, "Jewish supremacy is the law of the land." His comments point to concerns about the ideological direction signaled by the electoral outcome and its implications for Israeli governance and policy.

The remarks reflect ongoing debates over the nature of Israel's legal and political system, particularly regarding questions of equality and minority rights within the state's framework.
dek: ‘Jewish supremacy is the law of the land’ Middle East Eye spoke to Antony Loewenstein, an independent journalist, film-maker and author of The Palestine Laboratory , about the Israeli election results.
title: Journalist warns Jewish supremacy embedded in Israeli law after elections
